tokenSecurity.generation: CSPRNG (cryptographically secure pseudo-random number generator). Tokens must use at least 256 bits of entropy and be generated using a cryptographically secure method (e.g., secrets.token_urlsafe(32) in Python, crypto.randomBytes in Node.js).
tokenSecurity.binding: Token bound to candidateId and interviewId at generation time. Token lookup joins candidate to verify token-candidate-interview relationship before returning questions or accepting answers. Tokens are single-use per answer submission slot (each answer submission is a separate request).
tokenSecurity.expiry: Interview tokens expire after the configured deadline (default 7 days, subject to job-level configuration). Expired tokens return ERR_LINK_EXPIRED and do not expose candidate data.
tokenSecurity.revocation: HR Recruiter or HR Manager may manually revoke a token at any time before expiry. Revoked tokens immediately return ERR_LINK_EXPIRED. Revocation creates an audit event.
tokenSecurity.storage: Tokens stored as one-way hashed value (SHA-256 or better) in the database. Raw token never stored or logged. Only the hash is compared at lookup time.
tokenSecurity.transmission: Token transmitted only via the interview invitation email sent to the candidate's registered email address. Token never transmitted over insecure channels. No token in URL query strings for GET operations that return sensitive content; path parameter is acceptable when HTTPS is enforced.

interfaces.notes: Interview token ({token} in path) is a stateless bearer credential used to identify and authenticate the candidate session without requiring candidate login. It is not an OAuth or session token. The token is validated against the hashed store, binds to candidateId and interviewId, and is revoked or expires before re-use.

securityPrivacyCompliance.requirement: All internal HR/Admin screens and APIs require authenticated user identity.
securityPrivacyCompliance.implementationExpectation: Enforce login/session validation before access.
securityPrivacyCompliance.verification: Access unauthenticated request is rejected.

securityPrivacyCompliance.requirement: Candidate data and decision actions are role-bound to HR Recruiter, HR Manager, Interviewer, and Admin/IT permissions.
securityPrivacyCompliance.implementationExpectation: Role checks on screens/API actions.
securityPrivacyCompliance.verification: Unauthorized role cannot access/action candidate data.

securityPrivacyCompliance.requirement: CVs, transcripts, test submissions, and evaluations are sensitive candidate data.
securityPrivacyCompliance.implementationExpectation: Encrypt in transit/at rest; restrict access; avoid unnecessary exposure.
securityPrivacyCompliance.verification: Security review plus access-control tests.

securityPrivacyCompliance.requirement: All business decisions and sensitive workflow actions require immutable audit event.
securityPrivacyCompliance.implementationExpectation: Write Audit Event for state/approval/import/AI/notification/error actions.
securityPrivacyCompliance.verification: Audit coverage tests for each core workflow.

securityPrivacyCompliance.requirement: Google OAuth tokens and AI provider credentials must not be hardcoded.
securityPrivacyCompliance.implementationExpectation: Use environment variables or secret manager; validate presence at startup.
securityPrivacyCompliance.verification: Secret scan and config validation.

securityPrivacyCompliance.requirement: Uploaded files, forms, Drive events, and candidate answers are untrusted input.
securityPrivacyCompliance.implementationExpectation: Validate format, size, schema, and expected enum values.
securityPrivacyCompliance.verification: Boundary validation tests.

securityPrivacyCompliance.requirement: Errors must not leak OAuth tokens, prompts, model internals, or private candidate data.
securityPrivacyCompliance.implementationExpectation: Map internal errors to safe user messages.
securityPrivacyCompliance.verification: Error response tests.

securityPrivacyCompliance.requirement: Internal and candidate-facing screens must be keyboard accessible and not rely on color alone.
securityPrivacyCompliance.implementationExpectation: Semantic controls, focus states, labels, text alternatives.
securityPrivacyCompliance.verification: Automated and manual accessibility checks.

securityPrivacyCompliance.requirement: All screens and API actions enforce role-based access for HR Recruiter, HR Manager, Interviewer, Admin/IT, and Candidate.
securityPrivacyCompliance.implementationExpectation: Role-based checks on every screen navigation and API action. HR Recruiter: import, view pipeline, retry errors. HR Manager: approve, reject, defer, final decision, configure. Interviewer: view schedule and feedback. Admin/IT: configure integrations, monitor, manage users. Candidate: access own interview link, submit answers, withdraw.
securityPrivacyCompliance.verification: Unauthorized role attempt returns 403/redirect; authorized role can perform action.

securityPrivacyCompliance.requirement: All public-facing and internal APIs enforce rate limits to prevent abuse.
securityPrivacyCompliance.implementationExpectation: Rate limit headers (X-RateLimit-Limit/Remaining/Reset). Default internal API: 1000 req/min per user. Candidate interview API: 60 req/min per token. AI screening/grading: 30 req/min per job. Exceeding returns 429.
securityPrivacyCompliance.verification: Load test exceeding limit returns 429; headers present.

securityPrivacyCompliance.requirement: Uploaded files are size-limited and scanned for malware before storage.
securityPrivacyCompliance.implementationExpectation: Max 10 MB per CV/JD, 5 MB per test definition. Rejected files return 413 Payload Too Large. Malware scan before processing; infected files quarantined and logged.
securityPrivacyCompliance.verification: Upload >10 MB returns 413; scan of infected file is quarantined.

securityPrivacyCompliance.requirement: Google Drive push notifications and webhook events must be verified before processing.
securityPrivacyCompliance.implementationExpectation: Drive webhook signature verified using channel token from admin configuration (BQ-005). Channel token stored in secret manager. Invalid signature or missing token returns 401 Unauthorized.
securityPrivacyCompliance.verification: Invalid signature webhook returns 401; event not processed.

securityPrivacyCompliance.requirement: All state-changing API calls accept optional idempotency key to prevent duplicate execution.
securityPrivacyCompliance.implementationExpectation: Header: Idempotency-Key (UUID). Server stores key + result for 24h; replays result for duplicate key. Applies to: approval decisions, withdrawal, error remediation, email send.
securityPrivacyCompliance.verification: Duplicate request with same idempotency key returns same response without re-execution.

securityPrivacyCompliance.requirement: Google OAuth integration uses minimum required scopes per integration type.
securityPrivacyCompliance.implementationExpectation: Drive: readonly folder access + watch scope only. Calendar: read free/busy and create events scope only. Gmail: compose and send from specific alias only. No broad @dangerous scopes.
securityPrivacyCompliance.verification: OAuth token inspection shows only required scopes; excessive scope request rejected.

securityPrivacyCompliance.requirement: All browser-initiated state-changing API requests require CSRF token validation.
securityPrivacyCompliance.implementationExpectation: SameSite=Strict/Lax cookie + X-CSRF-Token header double-submit. All POST/PUT/DELETE/PATCH endpoints protected. Invalid/missing token returns 403.
securityPrivacyCompliance.verification: Request without CSRF token from browser context returns 403.

securityPrivacyCompliance.requirement: All HTTP responses include recommended security headers.
securityPrivacyCompliance.implementationExpectation: Strict-Transport-Security, X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff, X-Frame-Options: DENY, Referrer-Policy: strict-origin-when-cross-origin, Content-Security-Policy (per domain), Permissions-Policy: camera=(), microphone=(), geolocation=().
securityPrivacyCompliance.verification: Security scan of all responses includes required headers.

securityPrivacyCompliance.requirement: Candidate answers are validated and content-length limited to prevent prompt injection and abuse.
securityPrivacyCompliance.implementationExpectation: Max answer length: 4000 characters per answer. Oversized answers truncated at limit and flagged for review. Known prompt injection patterns sanitized or rejected; suspicious content logged. Prompt injection detected transitions to ERROR with manual review.
securityPrivacyCompliance.verification: Answer >4000 chars truncated; known injection patterns sanitized or rejected.

securityPrivacyCompliance.requirement: Candidate-facing interview and test screens display required privacy notice.
securityPrivacyCompliance.implementationExpectation: Privacy notice shown before interview start and test submission. Notice includes: data controller identity, purpose of processing, retention period (BQ-003), data subject rights, contact for complaints. Must be acknowledged before proceeding; acknowledgement logged.
securityPrivacyCompliance.verification: Privacy notice displayed and acknowledged before first answer submission; acknowledgement logged.

securityPrivacyCompliance.requirement: HR Manager and Admin/IT roles must authenticate with MFA for sensitive actions.
securityPrivacyCompliance.implementationExpectation: MFA enforced for exact sensitive actions: final pass/fail decision, integration configuration create/update/delete, audit log export, and bulk screening/scheduling approval actions. TOTP or hardware token accepted. Session invalidation after 30 minutes inactivity.
securityPrivacyCompliance.verification: Sensitive action without MFA rejected with MFA required prompt.

securityPrivacyCompliance.requirement: All candidate-facing and internal HR screens meet WCAG 2.2 Level AA.
securityPrivacyCompliance.implementationExpectation: WCAG 2.2 AA: 1.4.3 Contrast (4.5:1 text, 3:1 UI); 2.1.1 Keyboard; 2.4.7 Focus visible (2px outline min); 2.4.11 Focus not obscured; 2.5.3 Label in name; 4.1.2 Name/role/value. Candidate-facing: ARIA live regions (polite for queues, assertive for timer); focus management on question transitions; 44x44px min touch target; prefers-reduced-motion respected; table semantics (th/caption/scope); progress bars role=progressbar with aria-valuenow/min/max; field errors via aria-describedby; health charts tabular fallback; skip navigation link on all pages.
securityPrivacyCompliance.verification: Automated WCAG 2.2 scan passes; manual keyboard/screen reader testing passes for key workflows.

securityPrivacyCompliance.requirement: Only HR Manager or configured HR approver can approve generated content/design for external use.
securityPrivacyCompliance.implementationExpectation: RBAC check on approval APIs and UI actions.
securityPrivacyCompliance.verification: Unauthorized approval returns 403 and no state change.

securityPrivacyCompliance.requirement: Only HR Manager or configured HR approver can approve CV/interview translations for external use.
securityPrivacyCompliance.implementationExpectation: RBAC check on translation approval APIs.
securityPrivacyCompliance.verification: Unauthorized approval returns 403 and no state change.

securityPrivacyCompliance.requirement: CV Evidence Viewer access matches existing CV access policy.
securityPrivacyCompliance.implementationExpectation: Reuse candidate/CV authorization checks for evidence route and API.
securityPrivacyCompliance.verification: User without CV access receives 403/redirect.

securityPrivacyCompliance.requirement: Generated content, mock designs, CV translations, and interview translations must be marked AI-generated in UI and API.
securityPrivacyCompliance.implementationExpectation: Persist and render isAiGenerated flag and generation timestamp.
securityPrivacyCompliance.verification: UI/API contract tests verify AI flag visibility.

securityPrivacyCompliance.requirement: Translations and evidence views must link to original CV/interview records and never overwrite source of truth.
securityPrivacyCompliance.implementationExpectation: Immutable source references and audit events on generated artifacts.
securityPrivacyCompliance.verification: Traceability/source reference tests verify original IDs are present.

openQuestions.question: What exact AI confidence threshold requires manual review?
Who is backup approver and what escalation timing applies?
What retention/deletion policy applies to CVs, transcripts, test submissions, audit logs, and integration logs?
What coding sandbox/runtime is approved for coding challenge grading?
What exact Drive folder, ownership, webhook renewal, and naming convention should be used for MVP?
What final combined pass/fail policy should be applied across screening, interview, and test evidence?
What is the Calendar reschedule/cancel policy after event creation?

retryAndFallback.failureBehavior: On timeout, move candidate to ERROR with reason SCREENING_TIMEOUT, assign owner, alert configured channel, and do not advance automatically.
After exhaustion, route notification to ERROR, assign owner, alert configured channel, and keep candidate state unchanged.
After exhaustion, route scheduling item to ERROR and require HR/Admin remediation; no Calendar event is created.
After exhaustion, route to ERROR with manual grading/remediation owner and audit event.
After exhaustion, escalate to backup owner/Admin alert channel and keep item in ERROR; escalation never approves/rejects/skips.

retryAndFallback.contract: If owner inactive/unavailable, reassign to backup owner from Q4-002; if unset, alert Admin and HR Manager after 4 business hours unassigned.
retryAndFallback.failureBehavior: Alert and audit only; no automatic decision action.
If missed, mark evaluation stale, alert owner, and route to ERROR/manual review without advancing candidate.
